item.title: Woman winemaker brings life to small family-owned winery in Sonoma County
item.description: Nestled in the hills of Sonoma County is Karah Estate Vineyard, a family-owned winery that's been serving handcrafted wines and warm hospitality for 25 years. Under the direction of a skillful new winemaker, Lisa Albert, the family's vision comes to life.

item.title: Newly released bodycam video shows what led up to police fatally shooting carjacking suspect in SJ
item.description: The San Jose Police Department released bodycam video Sunday showing what led up to the January fatal shooting of a carjacking suspect who led police on a chase across several South Bay cities.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Mix of low clouds, fog could interfere with blood moon viewing overnight
item.description: Fair skies this evening, then expect areas of low clouds and fog overnight through tomorrow morning. This may interfere with viewing the total lunar eclipse for parts of the Bay Area, but you may see it in some areas where the clouds are slow to return.

item.title: Live's 'After the Oscars Show' Countdown begins on Hollywood's biggest morning
item.description: Emmy Award-Winning Hosts Kelly Ripa and Mark Consuelos will host "Live with Kelly and Mark' at the Famed Dolby Theatre the morning after the Oscars.

item.title: Proposal to require Californians to show ID to vote could be on November ballot
item.description: Supporters of a proposed California voter ID initiative say they have gathered roughly 1.3 million signatures in an effort to place the measure on the November ballot.

item.title: California measles outbreaks linked to pockets of unvaccinated residents
item.description: California health departments are fighting to contain measles outbreaks as cases rise and resources shrink. Investigating communicable diseases is time-intensive and expensive. Officials say teams have about 72 hours after a positive case to find exposed people and stop spread.

item.title: Newsom directs $291M to combat homelessness, touts Alameda Co. as model of success
item.description: Gov. Newsom recognized the success in Alameda County while announcing accountability measures for underperforming counties.

item.title: Supreme Court blocks law against schools outing transgender students to their parents in California
item.description: The Supreme Court cleared the way for California schools to tell parents if their children identify as transgender without getting the student's approval.

item.title: Children's and Family Emmy Awards held in NYC; Disney shatters record for most nominations
item.description: The Walt Disney Company shattered the record for most nominations, receiving 102.

item.title: Bay Area Iranian Americans react to death of Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, strikes on Iran
item.description: Many Iranian Americans are hopeful about developments in Iran and the changes that will come following the killing of Ayatollah Khamenei. Some of them have demonstrated here in the Bay Area to show their support.
